api:
<Waterfall data={bridge} name={|s: &Step| s.name} value={|s: &Step| s.change} />
PropTypeDefault
valueFn(&T) -> f64: the change at this step, + or −required
totalbool: add a final bar with the running totaltrue
total_labeltext"Total"
increase, decrease, total_colorcoloursgood, bad and the first series colour
show_valuesbooltrue
horizontalfalse

Each bar floats from the previous running total to the new one.

examples.title: Profit bridge
examples.description: Increases in green, decreases in red, the total in blue.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn profit() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[
        ("Revenue", 420.),
        ("Cost of sales", -180.),
        ("Marketing", -65.),
        ("Salaries", -110.),
        ("Other income", 25.),
        ("Tax", -22.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Waterfall data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} value={|s: &Step| s.value} total_label="Profit" class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Custom colours
examples.description: Subscriber movement with teal gains, orange losses and a purple total.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn colours() {
    let data = use_signal(steps(&[
        ("Opening", 300.),
        ("New", 120.),
        ("Expansion", 70.),
        ("Churn", -90.),
        ("Downgrade", -35.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Waterfall data={data} name={|s: &Step| s.name} value={|s: &Step| s.value} total_label="Closing" increase={rgb(0x179299)} decrease={rgb(0xfe640b)} total_color={rgb(0x8839ef)} class="h-72" /> }
}
